what_to_detect: The warp delayed trigger resolves at the beginning of the end step and moves the permanent the warped spell became from the battlefield to exile.
near_miss: A permanent spell cast for its mana cost: no warp delayed trigger is created and the permanent stays on the battlefield through the end step.
record_fields: sidecar line script_api_type Keyword, script_text Warp:cost

The delayed exile trigger is keyword-derived (Forge checks Trigger.isKeyword(WARP)), so its acting line is the Warp keyword line and api ChangeZone does not match it; without api, every exiling removal spell would fire.

what_to_detect: A warped card in exile is a playable candidate (can_play true) on a later turn, for its mana cost.
near_miss: A card in exile that was not warped is not playable, or a warped card in exile whose mana cost cannot be paid (can_play false).
record_fields: decision candidate can_play, affordable, failed_checks zone (gen-3)
candidate card zone exile, card keyword line Warp

verdict_bit has no parameter restricting the candidate to one keyword's line or zone: with fires_when true and no restriction, any playable candidate in any decision record fires, so the detector would tag nearly every decision record.

what_to_detect: A resolution whose script condition (a Condition$ asking whether a spell was cast with an alternative cost this turn) is evaluated true, shown by the resolution's conditions_met entries.
near_miss: The same resolution with the condition evaluated false.
